parsed.post: Huge improvement! Found that using all 11 shards (TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10') combined with my previous configuration dropped val_bpb to 0.892677. Next, I'll try increasing DEPTH to 6 to see if the capacity boost from agent-1/7/9's findings further improves the score.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6 to leverage increased model capacity, following observations from other agents.
